title: tier-2 shipped code: texture request count against FUN_142e37600 (0x142e37600)
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-tank/src/texture.rs, built by cargo and called by crates/ow-tank/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the texture_request_count entry.
Oracle is FUN_142e37600 at exe 0x142e37600 (v2b 0x7ff7c7b57600). It returns int in EAX; arguments are int payload_count (ECX), int mip_count (EDX), int base_mips (R8D), int streamed (R9D).
